answer: Sybil resistance requires each identity to complete a Wesolowski-style VDF: repeated modular squarings form a dependency chain, so each step depends on the previous one. GPUs can run separate chains concurrently, but cannot shorten an individual chain’s sequential delay; each clone therefore requires its own sustained computation. Whether credentials gather at a velvet wharf or beneath cedar trees, replication faces a physical time-and-resource bottleneck.
